about: The mutant ledger of internal/sketch/std: edits of the std sources (the .ergo declarations and the Go that reads them) that some test, law or example must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./internal/sketch/std; docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger", says when a change must run it and how to add a mutant. Seeded by ESC1 (wf10, lang audit B F1).

mutants.name: esc1-timeout-nonescaping
mutants.from: f escaping func() A fails E needs R
mutants.to: f func() A fails E needs R
mutants.rule: A joined child task is not the caller's task: a timeout callback cannot borrow a caller-owned Set.

mutants.name: esc1-transform-nonescaping
mutants.rule: types.md, Function values 2: a callback that runs on other tasks at the same time is escaping, so the capture rule refuses a write to the caller's let mut (lang audit B F1, probe race).

mutants.name: esc1-feed-nonescaping
mutants.from: run escaping func(send func(e E))) fails Stopped
mutants.to: run func(send func(e E))) fails Stopped
mutants.rule: std.ArgClauses: a Go body's parameter clause matches its review; ActorFeed runs run on a task of its own after feed returned.

mutants.name: t0-milliseconds-toward-zero
mutants.from: func Milliseconds(t Time) int64 { t.sec*1000 + t.nsec/1000000 }
mutants.rule: stdlib.md time 11: Milliseconds rounds down, as Go's t.UnixMilli(), on both sides of 1970.

mutants.name: t0-truncate-rounds
mutants.rule: stdlib.md time 11: Truncate is the last multiple of d at or before t.

mutants.name: t0-round-truncates
mutants.rule: stdlib.md time 11: Round is the nearest multiple of d, halfway up.

mutants.name: t0-interval-holds-end
mutants.rule: stdlib.md time 11: an Interval is half open; it never holds its end.

mutants.name: t0-touching-intervals-overlap
mutants.rule: stdlib.md time 11: intervals that only touch, or an empty one, do not overlap.

mutants.name: t0-interval-unchecked
mutants.rule: stdlib.md time 11: only NewInterval builds an Interval, and it fails Reversed when end is before start.

mutants.name: t0-compare-swapped
mutants.rule: stdlib.md time: Compare is Go's t.Compare(u), negative when t is before u.

mutants.name: t1-addmonths-no-clamp
mutants.from: daysFromCivil(y, m, if c.day > last { last } else { c.day })
mutants.rule: stdlib.md civil 4: AddMonths clamps the day to the new month's last day (31 January plus one month is in February).

mutants.name: t1-clamp-to-28
mutants.rule: stdlib.md civil 4: the clamp is to the new month's own last day.

mutants.name: t1-isleap-every-4
mutants.rule: stdlib.md civil: the proleptic Gregorian calendar; 1900 and 2100 are not leap years.

mutants.name: t1-isoweek-own-year
mutants.rule: stdlib.md civil 6: ISOWeek's year is the year of the week's Thursday (1 January 2027 is in week 53 of 2026).

mutants.name: t1-week-first-ignored
mutants.rule: stdlib.md civil 6: Weeks{First} names the day a week starts on; there is no default.

mutants.name: t1-between-not-from
mutants.from:
Days: DaysBetween(AddMonths(from, m), to)}
	case Years:
mutants.rule: stdlib.md civil 5: Between counts from from with Add's clamping, so Add(from, Between(from, to, u)) == to.

mutants.name: t1-saturation-wraps
mutants.rule: stdlib.md civil 3: arithmetic past the calendar's ends saturates at MinDate or MaxDate.

mutants.name: t1-span-exclusive-end
mutants.from: func Contains(s Span, d Date) bool { !Before(d, s.from) && !After(d, s.to) }
mutants.to: func Contains(s Span, d Date) bool { !Before(d, s.from) && Before(d, s.to) }
mutants.rule: stdlib.md civil 7: a Span holds both its ends.

mutants.name: t1-newdate-day-zero
mutants.from: year < 1 || year > 9999 || day < 1 || day > DaysIn(year, month)
mutants.to: year < 1 || year > 9999 || day < 0 || day > DaysIn(year, month)
mutants.rule: stdlib.md civil 2: NewDate fails NoSuchDate for a day that does not exist, day 0 included.

mutants.name: t2-resolve-drops-last-stretch
mutants.rule: stdlib.md tz 5: Resolve tests every stretch of the window, the one after its last change too.

mutants.name: t2-resolve-wrong-offset
mutants.rule: stdlib.md tz 5: a stretch is tested with its own offset, not the one before it.

mutants.name: t2-gap-before-after-swapped
mutants.from: Gap{Before: time.Unix(u - after, ns), After: time.Unix(u - before, ns),
mutants.to: Gap{Before: time.Unix(u - before, ns), After: time.Unix(u - after, ns),
mutants.rule: stdlib.md tz 1: Gap.Before reads the wall time with the offset after the change, Gap.After with the one before.

mutants.name: t2-gap-start-off-by-one
mutants.rule: stdlib.md tz 1: Gap.Start is the instant of the change.

mutants.name: t2-compatible-later
mutants.rule: stdlib.md tz 1: Compatible takes an Overlap's Earlier, as ECMA-262 and Temporal do.

mutants.name: t2-load-unknown-utc
mutants.rule: stdlib.md tz 2: Load of a name the copy does not hold is UnknownZone, never UTC.

mutants.name: t2-civil-wrong-instant
mutants.rule: stdlib.md tz: Civil reads the offset at t itself.

mutants.name: t2-startofday-gap-before
mutants.rule: stdlib.md tz 6: when a zone skips midnight, a day starts at the change.

mutants.name: t4-zero-pad-dropped
mutants.rule: stdlib.md civil 11: a ZeroPad number fills its width with zeros (MM writes 03).

mutants.name: t4-month-width-swapped
mutants.from:
case Full:
		full[i]
	case Short:
		short[i]
mutants.to:
case Full:
		short[i]
	case Short:
		full[i]
mutants.rule: stdlib.md civil 12: MMMM and January write the full name, MMM and Jan the short one.

mutants.name: t4-noon-is-zero
mutants.rule: stdlib.md civil 11: a 12-hour clock writes 12 for noon and midnight, as Go's 3 and LDML's h.

mutants.name: t4-fraction-untrimmed
mutants.rule: stdlib.md civil 11: a trimmed fraction (Go's .999) drops trailing zeros and writes nothing for zero.

mutants.name: t4-parse-trailing-text
mutants.from:
if i != len(s) {
		return ParseError{Text: s, At: i, Reason: "trailing text"}
mutants.to:
if false {
		return ParseError{Text: s, At: i, Reason: "trailing text"}
mutants.rule: stdlib.md civil 13: Parse reads the whole text; trailing text is a ParseError.

mutants.name: t4-two-digit-year-no-pivot
mutants.from:
if n == 2 {
			return badAt(text, t.at, "yy is
mutants.rule: stdlib.md civil 12: yy is refused in Pattern; a two-digit year needs an explicit pivot (F6, N3).

mutants.name: t4-week-year-as-year
mutants.rule: stdlib.md civil 12: YYYY without w is refused with the hint to write yyyy.
